title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10303)
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS IS_10303) covers Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10303). This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 6749 : 1984 'Earth-moving machinery— Preservation and storage', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adopted by the Council. This Indian Standard was first published in 1982. Consequent upon the revision of ISO standard, this standard is being revised by adopting the ISO standard under dual number system. The text of ISO standard has been approved for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain terminology and conventions are however not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as a decimal marker. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 'Earth-moving machinery — Operation and maintenance — Format and content

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
